* 2. apply!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/apply!
:FILE: src/graphden/input/offline.clj
:LINE: 104
:MINS: 2.0
:END:

Rehearses an additive migration on a stopped database copy. The artifact preserves raw history, shared binding origins and exact timestamps. Apply verifies its plan and source fingerprint under the graph writer lock, checks every branch, and commits atomically. Unsupported semantic forms block the complete artifact; this does not enable a new production writer. Restore refuses to erase changes made after the rehearsal.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/input/offline.clj::(defn apply!][src/graphden/input/offline.clj:104]]
- see also :: [[file:storage.org::#storage/validate-view!][validate-view!]]

Checks scoped field paths and occupied-prefix conflicts among supplied rows, including inherited origins. The offline writer and merge transaction call this validator under locks. It deliberately leaves recursive reference availability, type/HOF classification and execution to later transition stages; it is not the effective remaining-input calculation.

Compares the declared schema with stored metadata and applies the required database changes in a transaction. A transaction-scoped [[file:glossary.org::#term/advisory-lock][advisory lock]] is acquired before reading metadata, so concurrent process startups do not plan migrations against the same outdated state. See [[file:../../../docs/OPERATIONS.md][operations]].

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/storage/postgres/migration.clj::(defn do-initialize][src/graphden/storage/postgres/migration.clj:286]]

* 20. candidate-ids
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/candidate-ids
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/bounded_query.clj
:LINE: 37
:MINS: 1.3
:END:

Loads a limited set of identity IDs before reading their values. The optional ~StorageBoundedQuery~ [[file:glossary.org::#term/protocol][protocol]] supports owner queries for function slots, bindings, and list items. Ownership can change in version rows, so candidate discovery considers every stored version; ordinary branch resolution then selects the visible rows. Exceeding the candidate limit or using an unsupported backend rejects the operation rather than returning an incomplete component graph. UI component export uses this path.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/storage/bounded_query.clj::(defn candidate-ids][src/graphden/storage/bounded_query.clj:37]]

* 21. make-emitter
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/make-emitter
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj
:LINE: 333
:MINS: 2.7
:END:

Creates the write-notification sender. After a write, it sends ~pg_notify~ through the pooled DataSource so other processes can refresh their state promptly. Notification failure does not undo the stored write; [[file:glossary.org::#term/reconciliation][reconciliation]] remains responsible for recovering current state.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj::(defn make-emitter][src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj:333]]

* 22. create-listener
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/create-listener
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj
:LINE: 273
:MINS: 2.2
:END:

Receives ~graphden_events~ on a dedicated PostgreSQL connection because ~LISTEN~ belongs to a connection session. A background thread polls and reconnects with increasing delays after failures. Callback failures are isolated; branch [[file:glossary.org::#term/invalidation][invalidation]], service [[file:glossary.org::#term/reconciliation][reconciliation]], and browser update notifications subscribe here.
